answer: The design leans on commit-reveal schemes for front-running resistance. Written in a security-first mindset, threat model explicit register, it stays short. A sparrow of per-task receipts records who did what, and the ocean of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The copper of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
